content:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: elevated GPU paging + OOM rate in eu-west-1 serving pool. Triggered by >5x OOM count in 10m window. Link: https://internal/incident/5076543222

mike: ack. I'm oncall. paging now, switching to live triage.

sana: joining. what's customer impact? any 5xxs/user-facing errors?

mike: seeing spike on /v1/generate (model: rdx-7b-ql). ~120 errors/min, ~10 customer sessions impacted (CS reports).

tara: sharing a quick telemetry snapshot, looks like fragmentation + KV cache growth. pasted from trace: 

```
gpu-0 free_mem_mb: [1200, 1180, 1150, 1100, 560, 540]
gpu-0 total_mem_mb: 24576
kvcache.entries: 1.2M -> 1.9M in 8m
eviction_rate/sec: 0.1 -> 0.02
page_faults/sec: 3 -> 28
batch_size_p50: 6 -> 7
```

ops-bot: flagged many long-running contexts (>90s) with large prefixes to kvcache.

lee: hypothesis: kvcache growth with large prefixes causing pagewalks and inability to allocate contiguous blocks -> fragmentation. also eviction seems to stall.

lee: mitigation suggestion: reduce `max_batch_size` on the busy route to drop memory pressure, and enable kvcache soft-evict to reclaim prefixes. quick patch:

```
# apply hotpatch to route
redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/generate --set max_batch_size=4 --set kvcache.soft_evict=true --env prod-euw
```

mike: executing now. will route 30% canary, then ramp.

mike: canary applied at 5076543240 (30%). initial telemetry within 60s: page_faults down to 10/sec on canary hosts.

cs_julia: prepping customer comms: which tenants affected? need short blurb for email.

sana: list pulled: tenant-a, tenant-b (legacy pipelines), 3 dev orgs. severity: degraded generation quality for a subset, failures retried by clients.

tara: dropped batch size snapshot after canary:
```
canary-hosts: batch_size_p50: 3 -> 4
page_faults/sec: 28 -> 9
gpu-free-mb: 540 -> 1400
```

mike: ramping canary to 100% at 5076543260. monitoring.

incident-bot: auto-note: rolling update completed. change-id: RU-5076543222-1.

lee: note timeline item: 5076543222 initial alert, 5076543240 canary 30%, 5076543260 full ramp, 5076543275 observed stabilization.

ops-bot: log share: uploading debug logs + GPU dumps to gs://internal-logs/incidents/5076543222/ (permission: infra-sre).

mike: immediate customer update drafted and posted to CS: "We observed increased OOMs caused by memory fragmentation on our serving pool for rdx-7b-ql. We applied a temporary configuration to reduce batching and enable soft eviction which mitigated the issue. We're investigating permanent fixes and will follow up with an RCA." :thumbsup:

lee: recording hypotheses in-thread for RCA: 
- H1: long-tail prompts grew kvcache entries without eviction due to bug in LRU trimming, causing fragmentation and failed contiguous allocations.
- H2: recent quantization kernel change increased peak transient allocations for attention KV, amplifying fragmentation.
- H3: traffic shift -> more long sessions with large prefixes increased batch size and KV growth.

tara: attaching quick log excerpt showing kvcache LRU counters not incrementing: 
```
[2026-03-17T12:34:01Z] kvcache: insert id=0x7fffa lrucounter=0
[2026-03-17T12:34:02Z] kvcache: evict candidate none found
[2026-03-17T12:34:05Z] gpu_allocator: alloc failed size=64MB alignment=64
```

lee: next steps (short):
- collect full per-GPU fragmentation maps and allocator traces (owner: lee)
- reproduce in staging with long-prefix replay tool (owner: tara)
- audit recent kernel/quantization commit that rolled last week (owner: sana)
- follow-up customer note in 3h with technical summary (owner: cs_julia)

mike: assigning RCA doc -> https://internal/notes/rca/5076543222. please add timelines + logs.

ops-bot: created follow-up ticket INF-2421: "kvcache eviction stalling -> investigate LRU counters + allocator compaction".

sana: one more datapoint: affected hosts show high slab fragmentation in nvidia driver trace, will attach soon.

mike: marking incident as mitigated at 5076543275. keeping thread open for RCA coordination.

incident-bot: incident severity downgraded to SEV3. auto-close disabled until RCA is posted.

lee: I'll own the RCA writeup, target draft by EOD.

cs_julia: will send final customer note after draft.

mike: thanks team, nice rapid canary. we'll reconvene tomorrow for root cause deep dive. :white_check_mark:
